tools.name: lawhot_get_latest
tools.description: Get the latest LAWHOT items for a 24-hour or 7-day briefing. Prefer selected mode unless the user explicitly asks for every public item. Do not use this for named-topic search or multi-source event context.

tools.name: lawhot_search
tools.description: Search LAWHOT's latest 7 days by a 2–200 character topic, company, model, product, or person. It searches editorial picks first and automatically expands to all public items only when picks have no result.

tools.name: lawhot_get_hot_topics
tools.description: Get the current LAWHOT Top 10 with each event's one-based rank. Use this for 'what is hot now' and to discover valid story public IDs; use lawhot_get_latest for a chronological news list. Internal heat scores are not returned.

tools.name: lawhot_get_story
tools.description: Get the evolving timeline, latest development, AI digest, and related events for one public story. Only pass a public_id obtained from lawhot_get_hot_topics links.story; never invent or infer IDs.

tools.name: lawhot_get_daily
tools.description: Get LAWHOT's edited daily overview, either the latest issue or a real YYYY-MM-DD date. Use this when the user asks for a daily report rather than a raw chronological list.

tools.name: lawhot_get_weekly
tools.description: Get LAWHOT's edited weekly report: the week's most important events chosen from its dailies, grouped by section, with an overview. Use this for what happened this week or in a given ISO week; omit week for the latest.

tools.name: lawhot_get_monthly
tools.description: Get LAWHOT's edited monthly report: the month's most important events chosen from its dailies, grouped by section, with an overview. Use this for what happened this month or in a given month; omit month for the latest.
